title: Evaluate Reverse Polish Notation
prompt: Given an expression in reverse Polish notation as an array of tokens, return its integer value. Each token is either a whole number, which may be negative, or one of the operators plus, minus, and times written as the single characters +, -, and *. An operator applies to the two values produced just before it, with the earlier value on the left. The expression is always valid and has at least one token.
